A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''commander''' was in service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
[[File:Bad-Idea.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The officer moments before his death.]]
After the rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kento Marek]] was located by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] spies on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the Galactic Empire launched an [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|assault on the planet]]. The commander, who had been placed in charge of the Imperial forces fighting the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] rebels,<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> greeted the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader,]] upon arrival. Uninterested in the commander's excuses and lack of progress, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] cut the man off by Force-choking him. Still, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] singular focus on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rabble-rouser ultimately made him spare the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer's]] life. After Vader killed Kento Marek in his [[Kento Marek's hut|home]], he discovered the latter's son, [[Galen Marek|Galen]]. At that moment, the commander and several stormtroopers arrived and, expecting the Supreme Commander's approval, trained their blasters in the boy. Vader, however, had his own plans for Galen and protected him from his own troops' blaster fire. The Dark Lord of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] then killed the stormtroopers and the commander by reflecting the blaster shots with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], simultaneously cutting any loose ends.<ref name="TFUvg" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Commander in the PS2, Wii, and PSP versions of ''The Force Unleashed'' is a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Commander]]. He was strangled by Vader after landing on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In those versions, unlike in the Xbox 360 and PS3 versions, the commander's fate was left ambiguous as the scene immediately cut to behind the Dark Lord when he released his grip.

All Imperial officers in-game use this officer's character model.
